take this description and put emojies on it: In this episode of The Aesthetic Edge, host Bethany Gifford, founder of New Era Intel, sits down with Joe Stanoszek, visionary founder of VIO Med Spa — now boasting over 62 locations nationwide. From humble beginnings in the back of a tanning salon to building one of the fastest-growing medical aesthetics franchises in the country, Joe shares the raw, behind-the-scenes story of scaling a med spa brand from one local spot to a national powerhouse.

We cover:

How VIO Med Spa went from one room to 62+ thriving locations

Joe’s biggest growth lessons (and mistakes) when scaling a med spa franchise

Why culture is the secret weapon for long-term success

State-by-state med spa rules & how to navigate them

The real keys to client acquisition & retention in the aesthetics space

How to spot (and avoid) costly expansion mistakes

Joe’s proven marketing strategies — including a free syringe tactic that works like magic

The future of wellness in aesthetics and why now is the time to lean in

Whether you’re an injector, med spa owner, or future franchisee, this episode is packed with actionable insights to help you scale sustainably, keep your team aligned, and create a brand clients can’t stop talking about.

🎙 About The Aesthetic Edge:
The Aesthetic Edge is your insider pass to conversations with the most innovative leaders in medical aesthetics, med spa operations, and plastic surgery. Hosted by growth consultant Bethany Gifford, each episode delivers real-world strategies to grow revenue, streamline operations, and build brands people love.

Instagram: @neweraintel
